name: Vacuum extension 100 mm
description: Short hollow extension for the hand vacuum. Front end: a 35 mm push-in plug matching the nozzle opening (41.8 mm wide, one long side flat, the other curved out, 18 mm high at the ends and 20 mm in the middle; 0.2 mm clearance plus two small crush ribs per long side, small lead-in). Back end: a socket of the same shape (opening + 0.1 mm per side, small crush ribs inside) for the thin tongue of the old brush extension. The old tongue ends in a wider collar that must stay outside and is slanted, so the socket's rim is cut at that slant: the wall on the rounded side is 15 mm shorter than on the flat side (socket 45 mm deep on the flat side, 30 mm on the rounded side) and the collar lands flat on the rim. Straight air channel between. Prints standing on the plug end with the socket opening up, no supports. PETG or PLA, 3 perimeters. The old part's holes/latches are not copied: it holds by friction. Print the two short test pieces first. Not printed or fitted.
